Tadayasu could do all sorts himself, so his marks for other people came reluctantly.

If HE was impressed, wazan tha. That had weight.

Choosing Minato and forcing our company on him had apparently been the right move. By ourselves, we'd surely still be doing nothing but burning uselessly with impatience.
